marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 如何读懂孩子的心？ | Ru he du dong hai zi de xin?

This book guides parents on how to correct their wrong parenting concepts step by step from actual cases and the psychological needs of their children at different stages of development, analyzes the motives behind their children's deviant behaviors from the point of view of child psychologists, and guides parents on how to deal with the various behavioral problems of their children's growth paths, so that they can understand their children from another angle, and so that they can really read their children's hearts and find more sparkles in their children! Let parents understand their children from a different perspective, so that they can really read their children's hearts and discover more sparkling points in their children!
